2. Bahagian III Jadual Pertama kepada Akta itu adalah dipinda
dengan—
(a) memasukkan butiran "Sufentanil" selepas sahaja butiran
"Racemorphan"; dan
(b) memasukkan butiran "Tilidine" selepas sahaja butiran

3. Bahagian IV Jadual Pertama kepada Akta itu adalah dipinda

Tan Sri CHONG Hon NYAN,
Menteri Kesihatan

DANGEROUS DRUGS ACT 1952
(Revised-——1980)
DANGEROUS Dauas/ ORDER 1981

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 45a of the
Dangerous Drugs Act 1952 (Revised—1980), the Minister makes
the following Order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Dangerous Drugs/Order 1981.

2. Part III of the First Schedule to the Act is amended by—
(a) inserting the item "Sufentanil" immediately after the item
"Racemorphan"; and
(6) inserting the item "Tilidine" immediately after the item
"Thebaine".

3. Part IV of the First Schedule to the Act is amended by
inserting the item "Dextropropoxyphene" immediately after the
item "Codeine".

Made the 4th March 1981.
[KKM-S5 (58) Bhg. 5; PN. (PU) 214 Pt. III.]

TaN Sri CHONG Hon NYAN,
Minister of Health
